author: DaiqingChen
body: * **The annotation of collagen type VI trimer (GO:0005589) are as follow:** Only contains COL6A1, COL6A3 * **Gene product to be annotated to this term** For all species, add COL6A2 Three new collagen VI chains COL6A4, COL6A5 and COL6A6 in all vertebrate species that genome data is available for including mouse, rat, dog, platypus and lizard; However, COL6A4 genome has been disrupted in human, chimpanzee and gorilla. No functional collagen complex of these 3 genes have been found. * **Reference** [The collagen VI trimer complex](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/complexportal/complex/CPX-1736) contains COL6A1, COL6A2, COL6A3. The three new Collagen VI genes: PMID: 23869615.
title: Update gene product of collagen type VI trimer

author: Matrisome
body:
Yes, we should list all collagen VI genes under this term. 
For human: COL6A1, COL6A2, COL6A3, COL6A5, COL6A6
For mouse: ~Ol6a1~ Col6a1, Col6a2, Col6a3, Col6a4, Col6a5, Col6a6
